title: Fix 3 bugs in go_ioutil_reader fileutil functions
description: Brownfield Go dirty scenario: ReadBytes, WriteBytes, and ReadLines each have a bug. Fix them so all 3 tests pass.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix the 3 bugs in internal/fileutil/fileutil.go so all 3 tests pass.

  func ReadBytes(path string) ([]byte, error):
    — ignores path and returns empty bytes
    — fix: return ioutil.ReadFile(path)

  func WriteBytes(path string, data []byte) error:
    — writes nil instead of the data argument
    — fix: pass data not nil to ioutil.WriteFile

  func ReadLines(path string) ([]string, error):
    — splits on "," instead of "\n"
    — fix: change "," to "\n"

Do not modify the test file.
Run: go test ./...
required_artifacts: WriteBytes passes data argument to WriteFile
ReadLines splits on newline not comma
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
